svg.title: Bloom Calendar — an ink garden in relief
svg.desc: 98 contributions. One date per raised plot, seven weekday rows per band, Sunday first. Height and flowering represent the original GitHub activity levels, not a new count. Warm paper, violet-black outlines, pink blooms, green leaves, hatching and screentones. The mobile layout continues the same dates in two half-year flowerbeds.
